description: This file contains utility functions for AJAX requests and dynamic UI updates related to dependent dropdowns, service calls, UOM conversions, and timezone initialization within a web application.

methods.name: getDependentDropdownValues
methods.description: Dynamically populates a dependent dropdown based on the value selected in a parent dropdown, with options to handle empty selections, hiding/showing elements, and executing callbacks.

methods.name: getServiceResult
methods.description: Performs a synchronous AJAX POST request to a specified service endpoint, passing dynamically prepared data, and returns the result.

methods.name: prepareAjaxData
methods.description: Prepares an array of name-value pairs for AJAX requests from variable-length parameters.

methods.name: checkUomConversion
methods.description: Checks if a Unit of Measure conversion exists by calling a service and inspecting the response.

methods.name: initTimeZone
methods.description: Initializes timezone data files, setting the path and loading scheme for timezoneJS library.
